text:
Thanks guys! Two questions:

1. What does the following term mean? Does it give Encord access to our data for various uses, other than having it function through the software?

• 

4.3Client Input Use Rights. Client hereby grants to Encord a non-exclusive, non-transferable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Client Input to provide the Services, and to perform its rights and obligations under this Agreement. 

• 

2. Also - we didn't see anything about Uptime Expectations, Outage/Bug SLAs or similar - can we include something in the agreement? We typically don't sign SaaS agreements without well defined uptime expectations and SLAs with credits for issues.

Thanks!
Matt
